args.title: Fix merging issue in CSV export for different currencies
args.body: Issue 4206 reports a bug in `src/export/csv.ts`: when two transactions have the same date, amount, and description but different currencies (one in EUR and the other in USD), only one of them appears in the exported CSV. It seems that the CSV writer is merging these transactions incorrectly. This change aims to ensure that transactions with different currencies are treated distinctly in the export process.
